adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/worker-6 re-review resolved the open database/adjudication ticket for CaD23. The final record is publication-grade with cautions for absent linked sequence snapshots, coarse external database summary rows, and bounded mechanism scope.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Packet database has no linked_sequence_records rows; primary XML and supplementary image provide CaD23 sequence/purity, while database assay rows link by DOI/PMID/PMCID and DBAASP peptide id.
CAMP/dbAMP summary rows collapse multiple Table 1 MIC targets; final activity preserves target-level MIC rows.
Direct mechanism support is SYTOX membrane permeabilization for S. aureus ATCC SA29213; MD/CD evidence is supportive and not overpromoted to all tested strains.

materials_exhausted.note: Owner-layer re-review reopened XML/PDF, OA package, supplementary landing assets and Image1.JPEG, packet locators, and linked database JSONL rows. No blocking owner-layer source gap remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled all linked DBAASP assay/literature rows and CAMP/dbAMP summary rows against CaD23 sequence/name evidence, Table 1 MIC rows, Table 2 FICI rows, DOI/PMID/PMCID metadata, and supplementary purity evidence. Former source_conflict/database_only rows are resolved to source_verified with nonblocking granularity cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 final activity was repaired from XML Table 1/2 and Results prose: CaD23 MIC rows, FICI combination rows, and the SH1000 time-kill claim are target-specific with raw values, units, and locators. Antibiotic-only controls are deliberately excluded from AMP rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 final mechanism now separates direct SYTOX membrane permeabilization from supportive MD/CD/structure interpretation; no protein-synthesis or nucleic-acid auto-hits are promoted as CaD23 mechanisms.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_supplementary: Supplementary Image1.JPEG in the OA package was opened and supports >95% CaD23 purity; supplementary landing-page assets did not add activity/toxicity/mechanism tables.
